# plumber.R
library(plumber)
library(dplyr)
library(readr)

flights = read_csv("flights.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

get_data = function(origin, month, stat) {
  flights %>%
    filter(origin == !!origin, month == !!month) %>%
    group_by(carrier) %>%
    summarize(value = switch(stat,
      mean_arr_delay = mean(arr_delay, na.rm = TRUE),
      pct_late = mean(arr_delay > 15, na.rm = TRUE) * 100,
      n_flights = n()), .groups = "drop")
}

#* @param origin EWR, JFK or LGA
#* @param month 1 to 12
#* @param stat mean_arr_delay, pct_late or n_flights
#* @serializer json
#* @get /stat
function(origin = "JFK", month = 1, stat = "mean_arr_delay") {
  get_data(origin, as.integer(month), stat)
}

# testme.R
library(httr2)
library(dplyr)

resp = request("http://localhost:8000/stat") %>%
  req_url_query(origin = "JFK", month = 1, stat = "mean_arr_delay") %>%
  req_perform()
resp %>% resp_body_json(simplifyVector = TRUE)
